'''Kurdavvia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known for its bright sunrises. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]]'s face lit up like one when [[Sienn Sconn]] agreed to help her gain passage off of [[Rydonni Prime]].<ref name="ec" />
